{{Top|leg}}
A '''Pager Implant''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant. It allowed the individual with the implant to be silently summoned. [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] had one installed in his security [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Howzmin]].
